maya: Heads-up — BeaconHealth entering presales. They want predictable monthly billing, EU-only PHI processing, and a small burst pool for daily spikes. Need recommended reserve + preheat plan.
chet: Whats their traffic shape?
maya: Baseline ~120 qps, 95th = 450 qps, daily 10-15m spike to ~1k qps. Mix: chat generation (avg 1.5k tokens) + embeddings.
oscar: For that profile Id suggest reserving 3 A100-class GPUs (quantized) + 2 burst nodes. One reserved GPU ~120 qps at 1.5k context so 3 -> ~360 qps sustained; burst nodes cover spikes if preheated.
len a: Legal flagged audit retention and KMS. Customer wants 12mo logs and CMKs. Is private deploy required?
oscar: Hosted enterprise can extend log retention to 12mo + S3 export; CMK only in Private. Note this in quote.
chet: Pricing ask: can we include a small monthly rollover burst credit?
maya: They prefer 15% rollover credits. We usually offer burst credits that roll over up to 30 days for enterprise deals.
ops-bot: preheat note: scheduled warmup 20-40m recommended for stable p95 during spikes. Reactive warmup will increase early-p95.
oscar: Share this sample autoscale snippet for the POC:\n\n"scale_target: reserved_pool; min: 3; max: 5; scale_up_qps: 400; scale_down_qps: 250; preheat_minutes: 30; fallback_model: quantized-v2-small"\n\nmaya: Action items: oscar run a quick sim for quantized-v2-large (1.5k ctx) for p50/p95/p99 (ETA 24h), chet to draft pricing scenarios (A: 3 reserved + 15% credits, B: 5 reserved SLA), lena to draft security answers (ETA 48h). I'll consolidate and send to BeaconHealth.
chet: Ill include a ballpark delta for option B vs A.
oscar: Kicking sim now. results will upload to s3://redwood-poc-results/beacon/4270000000/
maya: Thanks team — keep thread tight so I can forward. :white_check_mark:
